doc.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001

title: Playing with California tenor players
summary: She names Harold Land, Teddy Edwards, Charles Lloyd and other local players she worked with.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And I read you played with quite a good list of tenor players early on.

Yeah, they were from California, Harold Land, Teddy Edwards, Charles Lloyd. Those are the people that you would recognize. There were other people who just kind of that lived in this area that you wouldn’t have heard of so much. Walter Benton was one of the major people there. Ray Graziano. There were other people but the people that we are speaking of are the ones that are kind of known all over.
